description: Production Web Audio API synthesis engine parameters, acoustic timbre models (Saraswati Veena, Vēṇu Flute, Human Voice Formants, Tambura Drone), gamaka curve generators, and unified orchestrator linking Raga Grammar, Tala Grids, and Guided Manodharma.

audio_pipeline_architecture.master_signal_chain: Source Oscillators / Noise -> Instrument Shaper / Filter -> Voice Gain (ADSR) -> Gamaka LFO / Pitch Modulator -> Instrument Sub-Mixer -> Stereo Panner -> Convolver Reverb (Temple Hall Simulation) -> Master Gain / Limiter -> AudioDestination

tuning_reference.default_kattai: 1 (C = 130.81 Hz for male, 261.63 Hz for female/child)
tuning_reference.microtone_engine: 22-Śruti Just Intonation exact ratios with cent micro-tuning

tambura.name: Tanpura / Tambura Concert Drone
tambura.description: Continuous four-string acoustic drone generating rich Jīvāri (buzzing overtones) across a repeating strum cycle.

nishada_sruti.name: Ni-Śruti (for ragas with prominent Nishada like Hindōḷam)

veena.name: Saraswati Veena (Carnatic Plucked Lute)
veena.description: Warm, resonant plucked string instrument with brass/bronze harmonics and wide fret-pull (gamaka) deflection capabilities.
veena.synthesis_technique: Karplus-Strong Plucked String Synthesis + Additive Jackwood Resonator Formant Bank

flute.name: Vēṇu (Carnatic Bamboo Flute)
flute.description: Sweet, organic blown bamboo pipe with gentle breath turbulence, warm cylindrical resonance, and fluid continuous vibrato (kampitam).
flute.synthesis_technique: Multi-Sine Odd-Harmonics Oscillator + Narrowband Noise Exciter + Formant Filter

voice_formants.name: Human Vocal Solfa Singing Engine
voice_formants.description: Formant filter model synthesizing authentic human vowel vocalizations for Kudimiyamalai singing syllables (sa, ri, ru, ga, gi, gu, ma, mi, pa, dha, dhi, dhu, na, ni, nu).
voice_formants.synthesis_technique: Glottal Pulse Waveform + Triple Bandpass Formant Bank + Pitch Micro-Jitter

gamaka_curve_library.description: Mathematical envelope models translating traditional Carnatic ornamentation into Web Audio AudioParam automation curves.

kampitam.name: Kampitam (Deep Oscillation)
kampitam.description: Continuous sinusoid/pendulum pitch swing around a specific microtonal center (crucial for G2 in Bhairavi, R1 in Todi, M2 in Varali).

nokku.name: Nōkku (Downward Push / Stressed Grip)
nokku.description: Starting slightly above or flicking rapidly from higher microtonal pitch down to the target note with a momentary accent.

sphuritam.name: Sphuritam (Accented Lower-Step Touch in Janta Varisai)
sphuritam.description: The second swara in a pair (e.g. S S, R R) touches the immediately lower note for 25 ms before striking the principal note with velocity stress.

jaru_ullasa.name: Ullāsa Jāru (Upward Portamento Slide)
jaru_ullasa.description: Continuous smooth glissando sliding up from a lower pitch to a target landing pitch.

jaru_iranga.name: Iṟaṅga Jāru (Downward Portamento Cascade)
jaru_iranga.description: Smooth descending glissando sliding downward from higher pitch to lower note.

temple_hall_convolver.name: South Indian Granite Temple Hall (Mandapam Simulation)

master_creative_suite_orchestrator.description: Unified orchestration schema connecting all four creative suite components into cohesive runtime game/training modes.
